answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh ember challenge every epoch. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its raven never becomes influence. The dune ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal dcdq4.
